name: Kuber Mehta
title: AI Developer & Full Stack Engineer

bio.intro: Hey! I'm an AI dev & Tech Enthusiast from New Delhi, India
bio.education: I'm studying Computer Science & AI-ML from BITS Pilani and AI & Data Science from IPU, primarily working on Generative UI for LLMs, World model caching and more @ PolyThink Labs.
bio.projects_highlight: I've built and shipped 53+ projects (38+ AI Based) in the past year, run Projects to see some of my favourites (that I can legally show lol.)
bio.blog_highlight: I also write a blog called MindDump averaging 50-500k readers per month.
bio.current_work: Depending on when you're reading this, I might have picked another cool Side Quest (probably listed on my GitHub profile readme).
bio.current_role: This summer I'm working on central AI Initiatives @ Razorpay (YC W15) — a 5-person mini AI lab reporting directly to CEO Harshil Mathur. We train foundational models and build large-scale internal and external AI applications on top of massive databases, at a company with 3500+ employees serving millions of merchants and billions of transactions.
bio.skills_highlight: I design agentic LLM pipelines, post-train models, optimise local RAG systems and play around with resource constrained projects like The Backdooms and PicoGPT, I'm an AI generalist, but to know what Languages and Tools I usually work with, run Skills
bio.history: Previously: Business Fellow @ Perplexity, AI Summer Resident @ Nas Daily (Dubai), AI Agents Websocket Framework LEAD Intern @ HTMX (thanks Twitter)
bio.fun_fact: Fun Fact: I started making games on Roblox when I was 12, made over 1 Million Robux by 14, at 16 I got into 3D modelling and won India's biggest student contest for it, and I almost went to culinary school at 17 because I sucked at math - glad it worked out though :)
bio.outro: At my core, I love Building (& Breaking) things, so if you're making something cool and ambitious, let's talk!

media_appearances.title: Anthropic Accidentally Leaked Claude Code's Source — The Internet Is Keeping It Forever
media_appearances.description: Coverage of the Claude Code source-code leak (a ~59.8MB sourcemap shipped in an npm release). Cites Kuber ("Kuberwastaken") as the source who surfaced details buried in the code, including a hidden 'Undercover Mode' subsystem; his archive and breakdown led to Claurst.

notable_moments.title: Reverse-engineered a $30 smart band into Google's Fitbit app
notable_moments.description: Reverse-engineered the BLE protocol of a ~$30 Huawei smart band and got Google's new Health/Fitbit app to recognize it as a 'Fitbit Air.' Went viral on X.

notable_moments.title: Pitched world-model caching to YC's Jared Friedman
notable_moments.description: Pitched his research on caching world models to YC partner Jared Friedman at Startup School Bangalore 2026 (2,000+ audience), who called it the "obvious future of the video games industry." The clip went viral on Instagram (~300k views) and X.

notable_moments.title: Co-hosted the biggest pre-event dinner at YC Startup School Bangalore 2026
notable_moments.description: Co-hosted the largest community pre-event dinner around YC Startup School Bangalore 2026 (30+ people, reportedly busier than the official YC partner dinner) — running ops remotely from Delhi.

red_team.title: Jailbroke Anthropic's 'Claude Mythos' to reveal its system prompt
red_team.description: While Anthropic's experimental 'Claude Mythos' model was live (~one day), Kuber jailbroke it to extract its full system prompt and published it as a public gist. Went viral on X.
